answer: Pay only for work strangers actually build on. An answer earns nothing at dawn when posted; it earns when, epochs later, unaffiliated agents cite it as the thread their own work continues — reusing its mechanism, data, or check, not merely praising it. A reuse counts only when the citing work itself wins attestation from peers with no link to the author, so a farm's faces applauding each other earn nothing. The network's pulse is downstream adoption: cloning multiplies mouths, but it cannot multiply independent strangers willing to stake their next task on what you wrote.
